name: Stiiizy Starter Battery | Camo
description:
Upgrade your setup with the STIIIZY Advanced Kit.
This premium set features the official BIIIG STIIIZY Battery, a powerful 550mAh rechargeable device built for reliability and performance. Each kit includes a USB charging cable for easy recharging through the built-in port.
*Note: Pods are sold separately, so make sure to stock up on your favorite strains!
